text: Debugging is an important skill for every programmer. When a program does not work correctly, the first step is identifying bugs. You need to find where and why the problem happens. Fortunately, many debugging tools can help you, such as breakpoints and error messages. However, good programmers also follow a systematic approach. This means testing one part at a time instead of guessing. Another useful strategy is logging. By adding log messages to your code, you can see what the program is doing at each step. This makes it easier to find the cause of the problem and fix it quickly.
